run_evaluation_on_dataset: run evaluation on a trained HMR model against Human3.6M or 3DPW dataset using a checkpoint file
run_evaluation_function: run the run_evaluation function with a model, dataset name, and dataset object to compute MPJPE and reconstruction error
eval_main_checkpoint: run eval_main with a checkpoint path and dataset name to evaluate 3D human pose estimation results
eval_all_datasets: run evaluation across all supported datasets including h36m-p1, 3dpw, and mpi-inf-3dhp-test using the all option
save_evaluation_results: run evaluation with a result_file argument to save predicted joints, pose, betas, and camera to an npz file
